recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It preserves the applied FHIR-17355 model and removes stale actual-vs-definitional wording that no longer maps directly to the current Group resource.
issue_request: FHIR-17355 was a Published/Persuasive CQI issue asking whether MeasureReport should point to Group rather than a List of patients, and its final application added support for Group-specified and Group-reported measures while preserving List for lists of individual MeasureReports and limiting the Group approach to matching population-basis cases.
initial_application: Commit 8bffead9c7e4fa14f41c966fea114be9b8e8eadd explicitly applied J#17355 by adding Measure.group.population.groupDefinition, Measure.group.stratifier.groupDefinition, Measure.group.stratifier.component.groupDefinition, MeasureReport.group.population.subjects, and MeasureReport.group.stratifier.stratum.population.subjects, while changing subjectResults wording to a List of individual-level MeasureReports rather than patients.
additional_context: Measure and MeasureReport are active CQI resources in source/fhir.ini. FHIR-23724 had replaced the old Group.actual boolean with required Group.membership codes, including definitional and enumerated, before the FHIR-17355 application. The originating Zulip thread supports the same split between definitional Group use in Measure and enumerated subject collections in MeasureReport.
reconciliation: Changed the authoritative Measure StructureDefinition comments so Group definition references SHALL have membership set to definitional, and changed the MeasureReport subjects comments so reporting Groups SHALL have membership set to enumerated. No generated SVG artifacts were edited.
source_changes: source/measure/structuredefinition-Measure.xml: updated three groupDefinition comments to require Group.membership = definitional.
source/measurereport/structuredefinition-MeasureReport.xml: updated two subjects comments to require Group.membership = enumerated.

related_jiras.note: Defines the current Group.membership code distinction that supersedes old Group.actual wording and supports the FHIR-17355 wording fix.
